title: SCAM
body:
I signed up for this app via an instagram ad and paid £7 for one course. I was then billed £37 in January (which I missed) and £37 in February. Future payments were not clearly noted on the initial order and no email confirmation was sent about future payments. 

Furthermore the app only allows you to manage the subscription via the AppStore but the subscription does not show in AppStore subscriptions so it’s impossible to unsubscribe. 

The owners have refused to refund the payments collected and instead offered to unlock lifetime VIP access for the money already paid. Which I do not want. 

This is clearly an attempt to trick people and scam them out of money. Their operations are illegal under UK consumer law and I have disputed the additional payments with my card provider. 

The majority of reviews on here are too similar to be real. The rest of the reviews like mine are likely the only real ones. AVOID

title: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE- SCAM
body:
I cannot give this app 0 stars unfortunately… but DO NOT SUBSCRIBE.
Firstly, the ads for the app are misleading. The app is difficult to use and to navigate and the ads pray on vulnerable people wishing to make genuine improvements in their lives- this is all A SCAM! 
Secondly, there is no option to cancel the subscription in Apple subscriptions as the app/ website suggest. So this is false information. 
Unfortunately, you can only view all the full context of the app after subscription, which I did through a social media platform. So you can’t see all the negative reviews- just the false advertising. I then received loads of spam email after I’d subscribed. Once I realised the app itself did not deliver its promises and was difficult to use I tried to cancel my subscription by emailing the company, I did this within the cancellation window. I emailed asking them to cancel my subscription and confirm no further payments would be taken from my account. However, each month a random payment amount has been taken from my bank. Each month I have emailed and they have refunded but I am 3 months in now and each time I receive the exact same reply email telling me I am unsubscribed and no further payments will be taken… 
I have raised a dispute with my bank and if this is not resolved I will have to go through the ombudsman here in the UK. 
I am not the only user having the issues by the reviews here

title: Suspicious experience – lack of transparency and poor communication
body:
I had a very disappointing experience with Ultiself that raised serious concerns for me.

Firstly, the “Manage App Store Subscription” button in the app does not work. There were no warnings or reminders before the subscription was renewed, and after a £31.04 charge on March 27, I did not receive any invoice or receipt—not from Ultiself, not from Apple.

I’ve been contacting their support daily for over a week, simply asking for an invoice for the payment. Despite several polite emails, I still haven’t received it. Instead, I keep getting promotional messages and offers to stay subscribed.

This behavior feels unprofessional and borderline scammy, especially considering how basic billing transparency is expected from any trustworthy service.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious before subscribing. This kind of lack of accountability and evasiveness is unacceptable.
